content: The Pomovirus is a genus of viruses that does not belong to any specific family. The virions are non-enveloped and have an elongated, rod-shaped structure. Both ends of the virions exhibit helical spirals. The genome of Pomovirus consists of a single, non-segmented, linear, positive-sense, single-stranded RNA molecule. The name Pomovirus is derived from its type species, the Potato mop-top virus. The genus Pomovirus includes the following species: Beet soil-borne virus Beet virus Q Broad bean necrosis virus Potato mop-top virus
